items.title: Bull of the Day: Hasbro (HAS)
items.summary: Hasbro (HAS) posted strong quarterly results with revenue climbing 15% YoY to $1.6 billion and adjusted EPS up 72% YoY. Magic: The Gathering sales surpassed $600 million for the first time, up 34% YoY. The company raised FY26 guidance and doubled its share buyback target. Shares have surged over 30% in the last three months, earning a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

items.title: Why Hasbro Stock Surged This Week
items.summary: Hasbro stock surged 18.9% this week following a strong Q3 earnings report with revenue of $1.60 billion (beating estimates of $1.48 billion) and adjusted EPS of $2.90 (vs. expected $1.86). Magic: The Gathering drove growth with revenue jumping 34% year-over-year to exceed $600 million for the first time. Management raised full-year revenue guidance to 7%-9% growth and doubled share repurchase targets to $400 million, reflecting strong cash flow and a successful shift toward higher-margin digital and tabletop gaming.

items.title: Why Hasbro Stock Jumped Today
items.summary: Hasbro stock surged 11.2% after reporting strong Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings with 15% revenue growth to $1.6 billion, driven by a 34% surge in Magic: The Gathering sales which exceeded $600 million quarterly revenue for the first time. The company's adjusted operating profit jumped 52% to $541 million, and adjusted EPS soared 73% to $2.90. Hasbro is doubling its stock buyback program from $200 million to $400 million and projects full-year revenue growth of 7-9% with operating margins of 27-28%.

items.title: Why Micron Technology Stock Soared 304% in the First Half of 2026 and Why There Might Be More to Come
items.summary: Micron Technology's stock surged 304% in the first half of 2026, driven by exceptional demand for memory and storage chips fueled by AI adoption. The company reported extraordinary financial results with Q2 revenue up 196% YoY and Q3 revenue up 346% YoY, with EPS surging over 13-fold. Management forecasts continued triple-digit growth for Q4 with revenue guidance of $50 billion and EPS of $31. The company has secured long-term contracts with major customers through 2030, and despite its meteoric rise, the stock trades at an attractive 21x earnings multiple.

items.title: Nvidia's Forward P/E Has Actually Fallen as Its Stock Price Rose. Here's How That's Possible.
items.summary: Despite Nvidia's stock rising 12% year-to-date, its forward P/E ratio has dropped from ~40 to 23.2, indicating the company has become cheaper. This paradox occurs because Nvidia's earnings growth has significantly outpaced its stock gains, with net income more than tripling year-over-year. The company's strong guidance for continued growth suggests the stock remains compelling for investors.

items.title: Samsung Was Priced for Perfection — Then Came the Reality Check
items.summary: Samsung posted exceptional Q2 results with operating income surging 19-fold and revenue more than doubling, driven by strong AI memory demand. However, the stock fell anyway, signaling that the market has priced in perfection and now demands continued acceleration. The article warns that while the AI boom remains real, the market is shifting focus from strong demand to whether demand can sustain the already-elevated earnings expectations, with risks from Chinese competition and potential slowdown in hyperscaler capex spending.

items.title: 3 Unstoppable Stocks to Buy Before the Next Market Rally -- Including Netflix (NFLX) Stock
items.summary: The article recommends three tech stocks as attractive buying opportunities: Netflix, which has fallen 47% but maintains strong long-term growth; Microsoft, down 24% with robust cloud and AI revenue growth; and Nvidia, up 27% but still reasonably valued with exceptional revenue growth driven by AI demand.

items.title: ZTS DEADLINE ALERT: ROSEN, TOP RANKED GLOBAL COUNSEL, Encourages Zoetis Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – ZTS
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Zoetis Inc. and ChampionX Corporation. The Zoetis lawsuit alleges the company made false statements about market share and product adoption while failing to disclose weakening sales of key products like Librela and Simparica Trio due to safety concerns and increased competition. The lead plaintiff deadline for the Zoetis case is July 27, 2026.

items.title: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Roblox Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – RBLX
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Roblox Corporation, Zoetis Inc., and Graphic Packaging Holding Company. The firm is seeking lead plaintiffs and encouraging investors who suffered losses to join the litigation. The Roblox case alleges the company made false statements about organic growth potential while concealing material adverse facts regarding age verification rollout impacts.

items.title: Nebius Stock's Massive Upside Comes With Serious Risks
items.summary: Nebius has emerged as an intriguing AI infrastructure stock with strong revenue growth and hyperscaler agreements, but faces significant challenges including valuation risk, capital intensity, and execution pressure. The key question is whether the company can become foundational AI infrastructure and justify the enormous expectations already priced into its stock.

items.title: 1 Dividend King Stock Down 25% to Buy Right Now
items.summary: S&P Global's stock has fallen 25% from its 52-week high due to AI disruption fears and disappointing 2026 earnings guidance. However, the company's dominant 50% market share in credit ratings, strong competitive moats, and 53-year dividend increase history make it an attractive buying opportunity at its lowest valuation since late 2022.

items.title: SRx Health Solutions Closes EMJX Acquisition and Launches AI-Driven Platform Strategy Under New Name and Brand, SRX Global, Focused on Investments in High-Conviction Operating Companies and Assets
items.summary: SRx Health Solutions has completed its acquisition of EMJ Crypto Technologies (EMJX) and rebranded as SRX Global Inc. The company is launching an AI-driven platform strategy focused on capital allocation into high-conviction operating companies and assets. The merged entity will be led by Kent Cunningham as CEO and Eric Jackson as President and Head of Asset Management, with initial investments in companies including Astro Capital, Opendoor Technologies, Uber Technologies, and Optimi Health Corp.

items.title: PayPal Shutters Venture Arm, Explores Portfolio Sales Amid Corporate Overhaul
items.summary: PayPal Holdings is closing its decade-old venture capital arm, PayPal Ventures, with staffing reduced to just two people from over 10. The company has engaged Jefferies to explore secondary-market sales of venture stakes. This move follows leadership changes, including new CEO Enrique Lores, and is part of broader cost-reduction efforts targeting $1.5 billion in savings and 20% staff cuts over two to three years.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase Is Eyeing 7% Net Interest Income Growth. Why That Goal Just Got Easier to Believe.
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase's 7% net interest income growth target for 2026 has become more achievable as interest rate expectations have shifted from anticipated cuts to potential increases due to rising inflation. While the bank didn't raise its guidance after Q1, higher rates would benefit its net interest income. However, the stock appears expensive relative to historical valuations, with investors potentially already pricing in positive developments.

items.title: Why First Advantage Stock Crushed the Market Today
items.summary: First Advantage (FA) stock surged nearly 6% on Friday after being added to the S&P SmallCap 600 index, replacing Kennedy-Wilson Holdings which is being acquired. The inclusion makes the employment verification company an instant target for index funds and comes as the company has been performing well with double-digit growth in recent quarters.
